## 主张 Claim

对每个约化与观测：观测经约化读出的是单值，恰在观测于约化所合并者之间相同之处；在约化合并的两个构型上，在两处都对的解码器存在恰当观测在那里一致，所以没有映射能恢复它合并的两个不同构型。在明示实振幅片段中，受控 X/Z 次序与完全退相干保留控制分支权重但改变固定测量响应；对角线合并加号响应不同的相干与退化矩阵，故仅凭对角线的解码失败；退相干合并制备与相干矩阵，故没有统一逆映射：两者都是实例。与空白寄存器的可逆交互经约化恰好实现退相干；保留共同状态允许精确反转。 / For every reduction and observable: what the observable reads through the reduction is single-valued exactly where it agrees across what the reduction merges; on two configurations the reduction merges, a decoder right at both exists exactly when the observable agrees there, so no map restores two different configurations it merges. In the specified real-amplitude fragment, controlled X/Z order and complete dephasing preserve control branch weights while changing a fixed measurement response; the diagonal merges the coherent and degraded matrices, whose plus responses differ, so a diagonal-only decoder fails, and dephasing merges the prepared and coherent matrices, so no uniform inverse exists: both are instances. A reversible interaction with a blank register realizes the dephasing on reduction, and retaining the joint state permits exact reversal.
